# Drone TikTok Product Video Brief V2

## Product
Screen Remote Foldable Drone

## Goal
Create a higher-conversion English TikTok product ad with stronger hook, faster subtitle rhythm, clearer beginner-friendly positioning, and a direct response CTA.

## Format
- 29.3-second vertical video
- 1080x1920
- English voiceover
- English subtitle rhythm
- Product-focused CTA

## Verified Claims Used
- Screen remote control
- No mobile phone required
- Dual cameras
- Dual camera switching
- 90 degree angle adjustment
- One-click takeoff
- One-click landing
- Headless mode
- Optical flow hovering
- 3.7V high-capacity battery
- LCD remote screen
- Two batteries shown
- Carrying case shown
- SD card shown
- Spare blades and guards shown

## Conversion Angle
- Hook around removing setup friction for beginners
- Emphasize "no phone needed" first
- Frame the product as easier to start, easier to control, and more complete out of the box
- Close with a clean tap-to-shop CTA

## Guardrails
- Do not invent range, GPS, follow mode, wind resistance, or camera resolution
- Do not claim pro-level aerial cinema
- Keep all product language anchored to visible image claims and included accessories
